name: io.github.Julian-dev28/pathiel
title: pathiel
description: Hyperliquid perps from an MCP client: market data, desk briefs, bracket orders. Testnet by default.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open: the server speaks MCP over stdio.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the client disconnects.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the folder that holds your pathiel env file, config and state.

pathiel_home.description: Absolute path to your pathiel folder, usually ~/.pathiel. Keys stay in its .env.local and never go in this config.

environmentVariables.name: PATHIEL_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Hyperliquid network: testnet (the default) or mainnet, which trades real money.
